appDescription: A companion app for coordinating appointments, passenger pickups and journey location sharing.

function.name: GET_PICKUP_STATUS
function.description: Get the status and next passenger of the selected pickup appointment.

function.name: START_PICKUP_NAVIGATION
function.description: Open confirmation to start vehicle navigation through the remaining pickups of the selected appointment.

function.name: NOTIFY_PICKUP_ARRIVAL
function.description: Open confirmation to notify the current passenger that the driver has arrived at the pickup point.
